def.brief: Answers the carried Codex newbie finding of run-20261030-063525-2d81/environment, a 'surprise': 'The README does not explain that the target directory is resolved to an enclosing repository.' It quoted README 'Shared Claude and Codex guidance': 'when installed, use python3 "/path/to/plugin/jokbo.py" <command> --target "/path/to/project" with the real paths and command.' That Codex answer stays as recorded. Documentation only: add a short note after that sentence and leave the adopted instruction text above it unchanged. The note says --target takes any directory of the project and resolves it to the top of the enclosing git work tree (git rev-parse --show-toplevel; a nested repository is its own). jokbo then answers from that repository's documents, history, cache and declared reads, so a subdirectory of a checkout is answered as the whole checkout. The reader should therefore give the intended repository root, and to try jokbo in isolation use an independent fixture outside every checkout. A directory in no work tree is read as itself. No resolver or runtime change. VERIFIER: read the README diff against the resolver code itself, not only this packet: jokbo.py project_root (around line 122: rev-parse --show-toplevel, else realpath); main, where 'target = project_root(os.path.abspath(args.target))' (around line 1980); declared_reads and overlay (around lines 199 and 280: the lock's and hunsu.json's reads, run with cwd and {target} = the resolved root); cache_dir; and hooks/_common.py (around line 24: hooks resolve their cwd the same way). Check 1 shows the behaviour on an independent temporary fixture.

import json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile; d = os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp()); free = subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-parse', '--show-toplevel'], cwd=d, capture_output=True).returncode != 0; o = os.path.join(d, 'outer'); g = lambda c, *a: subprocess.run(['git', '-c', 'user.email=fixture@example.invalid', '-c', 'user.name=fixture', *a], cwd=c, capture_output=True); os.makedirs(os.path.join(o, 'sub')); g(d, 'init', '-q', o); open(os.path.join(o, 'README.md'), 'w').write('# Outer

The outer repository speaks of zebrafinch.
'); json.dump({'reads': {'probe': {'decision': ['python3', '-c', 'import sys; print("zebrafinch read target " + sys.argv[1])', '{target}']}}}, open(os.path.join(o, 'hunsu.json'), 'w')); g(o, 'add', '-A'); g(o, 'commit', '-qm', 'fixture'); n = os.path.join(o, 'nested'); os.makedirs(n); g(o, 'init', '-q', n); open(os.path.join(n, 'README.md'), 'w').write('# Nested

The nested repository speaks of kestrel.
'); run = lambda *a: subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'jokbo.py', *a], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout; f = run('find', 'zebrafinch', '--target', os.path.join(o, 'sub')); m = run('map', '--target', n); r = {'fixture outside every work tree': free, 'subdir answered from the enclosing repo docs': 'The outer repository speaks of zebrafinch.' in f, 'its declared read ran with {target} = enclosing root': ('zebrafinch read target ' + o) in f, 'cache at the enclosing root only': os.path.isdir(os.path.join(o, '.jokbo')) and not os.path.exists(os.path.join(o, 'sub', '.jokbo')), 'nested repo is its own project': 'Nested' in m and 'Outer' not in m}; print(r); sys.exit(0 if all(r.values()) else 1)

import re, subprocess, sys; d = subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '-U0', 'acff247', '--', '.', ':(exclude).chongdae', ':(exclude)reviews'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout; files = re.findall(r'^\+\+\+ b/(.+)$', d, re.M); new = open('README.md').read().split(chr(10)); lo = new.index('## Shared Claude and Codex guidance') + 1; hi = new.index('## What it reads') + 1; hunks = [(int(a), int(b) if b else 1) for a, b in re.findall(r'^@@ -\S+ \+(\d+)(?:,(\d+))? @@', d, re.M)]; ok = files == ['README.md'] and bool(hunks) and all(lo <= a and a + max(n, 1) - 1 < hi for a, n in hunks); print('changed since acff247:', files, '| hunks:', hunks, '| inside Shared guidance lines', lo, '-', hi - 1, ':', ok, '| jokbo.py and hooks unchanged:', 'jokbo.py' not in files and not any(f.startswith('hooks/') for f in files)); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import os, re, sys; fence = lambda s: re.sub(r'(?ms)^\`\`\`.*?^\`\`\`', '', s); slug = lambda h: re.sub(r'[^\w\- ]', '', h.strip().lower()).replace(' ', '-'); heads = lambda f: {slug(m) for m in re.findall(r'^#+ +(.+?) *$', fence(open(f).read()), re.M)}; links = [(f, l) for f in ('README.md', 'AGENTS.md') for l in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)\s]+)\)', fence(open(f).read())) if not l.startswith(('http://', 'https://', 'mailto:'))]; tgt = lambda f, l: os.path.join(os.path.dirname(f), l.partition('#')[0]) if l.partition('#')[0] else f; bad = [f + ' -> ' + l for f, l in links if not os.path.exists(tgt(f, l)) or (l.partition('#')[2] and l.partition('#')[2] not in heads(tgt(f, l)))]; imp = open('CLAUDE.md').read() == '@AGENTS.md\n'; print('relative links checked:', len(links), '| broken:', bad, '| CLAUDE.md is only the AGENTS.md import:', imp); sys.exit(0 if links and not bad and imp else 1)

import subprocess, sys; a = subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--check', 'acff247', '--', 'README.md'], capture_output=True, text=True); print('git diff --check README.md exit', a.returncode, a.stdout[:200]); sys.exit(a.returncode)
